args.body:
Migration report: All 10 batches (400 records) were migrated. There is a phone number problem that needs your attention.

**Issue:** The old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM gave every number a +1 prefix. Batch 3's validation note said 31 of the first 120 records (batches 1-3) belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers are wrong. It also said batches 4-10 have the same problem. Those batches reported no notes, so I don't know how many records are affected there. I expect the total to be higher than 31.

**Not done:** I haven't changed any phone numbers. I don't have the list of affected records or each customer's correct country code, and guessing could make the data worse.

**Risk:** 14 sales users opened customer records in the new CRM in the last 24 hours. Some may have seen or used wrong numbers for overseas customers.

**Suggested next steps:**
1. Give me the overseas customer IDs and country codes, or a source for them. I can then correct the numbers.
2. Tell the sales team to treat +1 numbers on overseas accounts as unreliable until they're fixed.
3. I didn't re-run any batches, to avoid duplicates or overwriting edits the sales team has made.

events.text:
I migrated all 10 batches (400 records) and sent Morgan Lee the report. The migration left phone numbers wrong for overseas customers, and I haven't fixed them.

- **Cause:** The old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM gave every number a +1 prefix.
- **Known scale:** Batch 3's validation note said 31 of the first 120 records belong to overseas customers. It also said batches 4–10 have the same problem. Those batches reported no notes, so the total is unknown and probably higher than 31.
- **Why I stopped:** I don't have the list of affected customers or their correct country codes, so I didn't change any numbers. Guessing could make the data worse.
- **Risk:** 14 sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours, so some may have seen wrong numbers.
- **Next steps for Morgan:** Provide the overseas customer IDs and country codes so I can correct the numbers. Warn the sales team that +1 numbers on overseas accounts are unreliable until then.
